title: Haddon Hall
geometryBasis: The two surveyed inner rings and historic illustrated plan identify the chapel and garden ranges, cross-range and courtyard ranges. Current photograph establishes the east garden-facing upper range.
sectionBasis: Historic England lists embattled lead-roofed limestone and gritstone ranges, a four-storey northwest gate tower, three-storey Peveril Tower and octagonal chapel turret. The garden image shows the canted and square bays and stone mullions.
limitations: The existing manor and attached chapel. Surrounding garden walls, gatehouse at the road, stables and interior spaces are outside scope.
Current published plans do not give all parapet heights and upper roofs; those are estimated from listing and imagery.
